title: Spherical Mirror
definition: A spherical mirror is a reflecting surface forming part of a hollow sphere, categorized into concave (converging) and convex (diverging) mirrors, fundamental to geometric optics and wave reflection principles.
importanceInUpsc: Essential microtopic under General Science (Physics - Cosmic Physics / Optics) tested via direct conceptual Prelims MCQs and applied utility questions in science and technology.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Spherical Mirrors.
Evaluate ray diagram formations, sign conventions, and mirror equation applications.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims sign-convention and image-formation questions.
